about: Modwerk source-only quick-velocity-aftertouch-assign package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/quick-velocity-aftertouch-assign.

mods.title: Improved Mod Assign
mods.summary: Hold FIX, SAMPLER or LFO and turn a knob to link that parameter to velocity, aftertouch or the LFO; hold SCENE and turn to lock it in a scene.
mods.description: Hold FIX and turn a knob on a sound page to link that parameter to velocity, SAMPLER for aftertouch, or LFO to make it the LFO's destination; further turns set the amount or the LFO's depth. It fills the sound's own four velocity and four aftertouch mod slots and its LFO destination and depth, and while the key is held each linked knob shows its amount as a performance lock does. Holding SCENE shows the scene's locks and a turn locks that parameter in the active scene (or the last engaged one, or the one scene edit shows) without opening scene edit; pads during the hold pick tracks, REC, STOP and PLAY copy, paste and clear the scene, and a hold let go with nothing touched opens scene edit on the release.
mods.author: npp1993
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: 0.1 passed links, display, kit save, reload and power cycle; 0.2.0 the test rig's cases and hand checks of the LFO assign; 0.3.x hand checks of the half-second look and the rig's cases. 0.4.0's source passed the test rig's scene cases (QS02, QS03, QS05) and the author's hand tests of the scene locks, pads, scene edit and copy/paste/clear on private development images (QS07, QS09); this package's own image ran in rytm-emu only.
